name: Vector

source.code:
/-- `Vector α n` is an `Array α` with size `n`. -/
structure Vector (α : Type u) (n : Nat) where
  /-- The underlying array. -/
  toArray : Array α
  /-- Array size. -/
  size_toArray : toArray.size = n
deriving Repr, DecidableEq
